usage: xo def [--dir=DIR] [--json] NAME

Where NAME is declared, with its signature and doc comment. NAME is
written as code writes it: `greet`, `Counter.next`, `Str.find`,
`check.Checker.check_dirs`, `std/tls.client`; std and runtime modules
load when a name refers to them (decision 0289). Text: the place, the
doc comment's first line, the signature (xo doc NAME has the whole
doc and the methods).

--dir=DIR checks the program in DIR (default .; a workspace or
repository root checks the modules under it).
Output is compact text, a record a line, so grep and head cut it
(decision 0386); --json is the same answer as JSON, broken over lines
with a flat record (a reference, a symbol) on one line. Exit status: 0
with an answer, 1 for no match, 2 for a usage error.
